text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day before the debut race.
We head out for some light roadwork for training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, the racecourse... Trainer, would it be okay if we stopped by for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about my debut race tomorrow is making me so nervous...!
If I can get even a little used to it, it might help—"
choice_data_list: Got it, shall we do that then?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
She's making her debut tomorrow!
Fufu, she seems nervous. So cuuute~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, feels like your heart's pounding on the inside!
Oh, heading towards the stands...
Going to watch the next Make Debut race, are you!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Everyone safely crossed the finish line—whoa, the applause...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...I can feel everyone's warm feelings. Tomorrow... I want to be enveloped in this applause, too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Huh, running in tomorrow's Make a Debut, huh?
Is that girl... Royce and Royce?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Inspecting the course the day before the race? That's dedication.
I'm definitely keeping my eye on her!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ......Ufufu.
choice_data_list: ("All according to plan!" ...is probably what she's thinking.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of the debut race—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I took a walk through the spectator stands earlier.
There were a few people who waved at me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
They must have learned about me
from the racetrack or through videos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before her debut, there were already people who recognized Royce and Royce.
Her self-producing had truly paid off!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the people who have shown an interest in me...
I definitely won't let them go!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: By the way, there's something I wanted to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Would you please keep in mind the spectators who are cheering for me?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, it would be even more certain if you could jot down the characteristics.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'll explain after the race. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here comes the girl from yesterday!
Royce and Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(My palms are slowly getting sweaty...
Could I... be nervous?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Now that I'm conscious of it, it's even worse... Ah... this is bad... what should I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Royce's Stream Viewer
text_block_list.text:
"Royce-chaaaan! We're here to cheer for you!"
"I've been waiting for this! Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
...Um, calling me like that is...—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The people from the video comments...!
Everyone... you really came!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Stream Viewer
text_block_list.text:
"Of course you will!! Do your best!"
"Congrats on your debut! Aim for victory!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (So many more people came than I expected...! All my self-producing up until now has truly borne fruit...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine now.
I cannot show everyone a shameful run."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Royce, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Well, I've done everything I can.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: From here on, it's all-out serious competition—!
